[ \""'$(head -n1 "$counts" | cut -f1)" = gene ]

actual_header=$(head -n1 "$counts" | cut -f2-)
expected_header=$(awk -F '"'\\t' 'BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"} NR>1{x="'$3"_"$5;gsub(/[- ]/,"_",x);a[++n]=x} END{for(i=1;i<=n;i++)printf "%s%s",a[i],(i<n?OFS:ORS)}'"' \""'$meta")

[ "$(tail -n +2 "$counts" | cut -f1 | sort | uniq -d | wc -l)" -eq 0 ]
filter_diff=$(comm -3 <(awk -F '"'\\t' 'NR==FNR{if(FNR>1)tot[++n]="'$7+0;next} FNR==1{next} {k=0;s=0;for(i=2;i<=NF;i++){v=$i+0;s+=v;if(v*556360>=10*tot[i-1])k++}if(k>=27&&s>=1000)print $1}'"' \""'$meta" "$unfiltered" | sort) <(tail -n +2 "$counts" | cut -f1 | sort) | wc -l)

[ "$(head -n1 "$de")" = $'"'gene\\tlog2_fold_change\\tp_value\\tfdr' ]
[ \""'$(wc -l < "$de")" -eq 1430 ]
awk -F '"'\\t' 'BEGIN{num=\""'^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$"} NR>1{if(NF!=4||$2!~num||$3!~num||$4!~num||$3+0<0||$3+0>1||$4+0<0||$4+0>1)bad++}END{if(bad)exit 1}'"' \""'$de"

[ "$gene_diff" -eq 0 ]
bh=$(tail -n +2 "$de" | awk -F '"'\\t' '{print "'$3"'"\\t\""'$4}'"' | sort -g -k1,1 | awk -F '\\t' '{p[NR]="'$1;f[NR]=$2}END{prev=2;for(i=NR;i>=1;i--){q=NR*p[i]/i;if(q>1)q=1;if(q>prev)q=prev;prev=q;d=q-f[i];if(d<0)d=-d;if(d>mx)mx=d}printf "%.17g",mx+0}'"')
awk -v d=\""'$bh" '"'BEGIN{if(d>1e-12)exit 1}'
[ \""'$(find final_answer -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 3 ]
